visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an extreme close-up of a finished ramen bowl, showcasing pink chashu slices, a soft-boiled egg, wood ear mushrooms, and a dollop of red chili paste. (2) The scene shifts to the kitchen where a thick, creamy white liquid is poured through a sieve into a bowl. A massive industrial pot is seen boiling with milky white pork bone broth and large bones inside. (3) A chef's gloved hands use a knife to slice thick pieces of marinated pork on a white plastic cutting board, showing the fatty and lean textures. (4) Different noodle types are showcased: thin noodles are strained from a basket, and thick noodles are lifted by chopsticks from a dark broth. (5) Further close-ups reveal toppings being added, including a mountain of chopped green onions being poured from a black bowl, bamboo shoots, and a half-cut soft-boiled egg with a runny yolk. (6) Side dishes such as golden-brown fried chicken and dumplings are briefly shown on black rectangular plates. (7) The final shots depict the restaurant's interior with a long wooden counter and the exterior storefront featuring a large white sign with black calligraphy.
